title: Compose the chain canvas
question: The roll assigned Single Face Chassis — the canvas as one continuous instrument faceplate. Keep it, take an alternate composition, or re-roll.

options.label: Single Face Chassis
options.lineage: modular synth faceplates and console chassis
options.thesis: The canvas is one continuous instrument faceplate: mic in and out as silkscreened jacks, each effect a panel-print section separated by a machined groove — never a floating card.
options.viewport: One chassis face top to bottom: in jack at top-left with its meter, knob-cluster sections in chain order each with a print label block, out jack and the VU corner at bottom-right, the display register etched along the top edge.
options.risk: With no card edges, drag-to-reorder and remove must read as explicit panel parts, and the touched section's lift has to carry focus without a shadow to lean on.

regions.label: MIC IN jack + in meter (top-left print)
SECTION 04 collapsed (folded to a groove line)

options.label: 1U Rack Rows
options.thesis: Every effect is a single rack line: grip, family print, and all one-to-four controls inline across one row, so the chain reads like outboard gear racked top to bottom.
options.viewport: In jack at top, then one line per module with encoders, pads, and mini-sliders inline, out with the VU corner at the foot, the touched control's exact value on the pinned display line.
options.risk: A single line leaves no room to grow: a module that ever needs more than four controls or a long-throw precision slider forces a pop-down tray, adding a second chrome state.

regions.label: UNIT 01 · grip + family print + inline encoders

options.label: Rack and Drawer
options.lineage: groovebox track control, one page at a time
options.thesis: The rail is a rack of closed module spines; the touched module alone pulls out as a full knob drawer, so the hand works one module at a time while its neighbors recede.
options.viewport: In jack at top, closed numbered spines down the rack, the selected spine open as one drawer carrying its whole knob cluster and pad bank, out and VU at the foot, display line pinned on top.
options.risk: Only one module's controls are visible at once — twisting a distant module mid-show costs a selection first, and closed spines must keep their controls keyboard-reachable and agent-addressable.

regions.label: DRAWER header · open module + collapse + remove
